definitions: A configuration setting or variable that specifies the duration for which a JSON Web Token (JWT) remains valid before it expires.
The time-to-live (TTL) value assigned to a JWT, indicating when it will no longer be considered valid for authentication or authorization purposes.
examples: Set the JWT_EXPIRES_IN to '1h' for a one-hour token validity.
The application checks JWT_EXPIRES_IN to manage session timeouts.
A short JWT_EXPIRES_IN enhances security by limiting token exposure.
